fields.label: Require Sales Demand on Job Order
fields.description: When enabled, Job Orders cannot be saved without a linked APC Sales Demand. When disabled (default) Job Orders work standalone.

fields.label: Enable Zoho Dispatch Sync
fields.description: Master toggle for the push pipeline that fires when a Gate Pass is released (DN → COA → Invoice).

fields.label: Stub Network Calls (Skip Real API)
fields.description: Leave on while real Zoho Books credentials are not provisioned. Calls are logged to Zoho Sync Log but no HTTP requests are made.

fields.label: Default Import DO Customer
fields.description: Optional fallback if no Customer named APC exists. Import Delivery Orders normally use Customer APC.

fields.label: QC Manager Role
fields.description: Role required to approve Loading DN ↔ COA binding before Zoho push.

fields.label: Loading Quantity Tolerance (%)
fields.description: Allowed discrepancy between allocated and actual loaded quantity when reconciling Loading Entries against Batch Allocations.
